background: CIC is a French retail and corporate bank, the main non-mutual subsidiary of Credit Mutuel Alliance Federale, with a regional branch network across France and a corporate and investment banking arm.
synthesis: Ratings are AA- on average across all three main agencies, the weakest of them at A+, after a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 12 May 2026, but one of the three has the bank on a negative outlook where the other two are stable. The ratios are on the weak side of EU and Nordic peers: CET1 of 12.6% is in the bottom quarter, leverage of 4.7% is below the peer median, LCR of 146% is below the peer median and NSFR of 108% is in the bottom quarter. None of the ratios has moved materially over the past four periods, with figures to 31 Mar 2026, and nothing has been flagged in the last 90 days. The comfort here is the mutual group behind it rather than the subsidiary's own ratios.
